bull_case: VAS and commercial/money movement can sustain above-core growth and support Bull economics.
bear_case: A de-rating toward lower historical multiples combined with regulation can create large mark-to-market downside even without business impairment.
thesis: The business has low existential risk but only moderate valuation asymmetry at $368.29. Upside exists through VAS, cross-border and money movement, while the main downside is multiple compression rather than solvency.

evidence.claim: Bull/current is about 1.27x and Bear/current about 0.36x.
Q3 payments volume grew 10%, cross-border ex-Europe 12%, processed transactions 10%.

counterevidence: Regulatory and interchange litigation can pressure network economics and pricing over time.
The current valuation already embeds a high-quality compounder profile.
unknowns: Long-run regulation of interchange and routing
Sustainable growth rate of Visa Direct and value-added services
falsifiers: If processed transactions and payments volume decelerate materially while client incentives rise faster than gross revenue, the moat/FCF thesis weakens.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Strong recurring cash generation and network economics make bankruptcy/forced financing risk remote; downside is valuation/regulatory, not survival.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is above locked Base but remains below Bull; the market price does not require an unrealistic Bull+ outcome.

next_checks: Payments volume, cross-border volume, processed transactions, value-added services, client incentives, owner FCF/share, buyback price
